features.title: Arcane scholar
features.text: Prepare spells from a growing spellbook. You can specialize in damage, control or exploration, but the spells you prepare determine which answers you have today.

features.title: School and thesis
features.text: Your curriculum and thesis shape your tools. A bonded item can recover a spell you have already used, giving limited flexibility when plans change.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3 → 3–5. Prepared offensive spells enable excellent area or burst damage; a control loadout deals less directly.
ratings.defense: 1 → 2. Low HP and no initial armor training make defensive spell choices important.
ratings.support: 4.5 → 3.5–5. Arcane control, debuffs and buffs offer exceptional support when prepared for it.
ratings.utility: 5 → 5. A broad arcane spellbook and Intelligence offer many noncombat answers, subject to preparation.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Spellbook choices, daily slots and school tools require ongoing preparation.
